import os
os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY'] = '[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]'

import requests
api_key = '[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]'
dataset_id = 'f9cad7b01a4721357c70cfc14df38815'
history_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b590219375f807f0b1'

# Try the history contents endpoint first to check the dataset state
url = f'https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/{history_id}/contents/{dataset_id}'
r = requests.get(url, headers={'x-api-key': api_key}, timeout=30)
print(f"Status: {r.status_code}")
dataset_info = r.json()
print(f"Name: {dataset_info.get('name')}")
print(f"State: {dataset_info.get('state')}")
print(f"Extension: {dataset_info.get('extension')}")
print(f"File size: {dataset_info.get('file_size')}")

# Now try to download
download_url = f'https://usegalaxy.org/api/datasets/{dataset_id}/display'
r2 = requests.get(download_url, headers={'x-api-key': api_key}, timeout=30)
print(f"\nDownload status: {r2.status_code}")
if r2.status_code == 200:
    content = r2.text
    print(content[:5000])
PYEOF
